label: ASTR v13 exploratory feature-ablation variants
source: NASA Exoplanet Archive q1_q17_dr25_koi, original 8054-row filtered table
model: RandomForestClassifier, n_estimators=120, max_depth=9, min_samples_leaf=3, random_state=12600; training-median imputation, log1p input
primary_metric: balanced accuracy for All four minus Without depth on original 1619 KOIs
secondary_metric: AUROC, candidate recall, historical false-positive rate
group_bootstrap: 1200 whole-host-star resamples for primary contrast, seed 20261115
inferential_scope: Exploratory reanalysis of already examined test split; no independent confirmation; raw dataset and full NASA model architecture unchanged.
